summary: Razorpay 502 fix VERIFIED end-to-end. Focused suite tests/test_checkout_502.py 43/43 PASS (14.42s). Full backend regression 649 passed / 9 skipped in 235.36s — matches the review-request baseline exactly. Independent verification (/tmp/independent_verify.py, 13/13 PASS): (1) reuse — same account/same amount second POST returns reused=true with identical order_id and checkout_url and db.payments still holds exactly ONE record for the wallet_key; different amount, different account, captured link, and expired link all create a NEW link (no cross-contamination); (2) fake phone +919999999999 -> 400 detail="contact_invalid:phone:Payments won't accept a made-up number. Enter your real mobile number.", ZERO payments records created, Razorpay never called; (3) all five real numbers (+918291026256, +919812345678, +14155550134, +447911123456, +6591234567) accepted by contact_rejection. Frontend smoke on mobile viewport 390x844: AUTH_DEBUG_RETURN_OTP=true (temporary) -> fresh email OTP sign-in -> consent accepted -> AGENTS tab -> topup-5 tapped -> contact-prompt opens -> fake number 9999999999 -> testID contact-error shows exactly "Payments won't accept a made-up number. Enter your real mobile number.", the sheet STAYS OPEN (no alert, no 502) -> replaced with +919812345678 -> sheet closes and proceeds toward the payment page (routed to rzp.io was intercepted/aborted so nothing was actually opened; no payment link needed cancelling because the CLIENT-side check submitContact caught the fake number before /pay/order was called on the second submit too — mirrors the server rule as designed). AUTH_DEBUG_RETURN_OTP restored to false and backend restarted, verified on disk. No red screen, no console errors, tab clicks by testID / page.get_by_text('AGENTS', exact=True) work. Code-path audit for 'any remaining path that still turns a user-input problem into a 502' in routes/payments.create_topup_order and razorpay_pay.razorpay_request: NONE FOUND — amount is validated locally (400), currency is server-locked, customer name is sanitized locally as insurance, description/notes/callback_url/reference_id are all server-composed, and every RazorpayError is triaged into (a) is_rate_limited -> 503 busy:, (b) customer_field_for(description) match -> 400 contact_invalid:<field>:<razorpay's own words>, (c) everything else -> 502 with Razorpay's description; the empty-body case is covered because razorpay_request now falls back to '<status> <reason>: <text[:200]>' when err.description is empty, and test_an_empty_error_body_still_says_something proves it. Rate-limit path retries exactly once (0.7s) and a rejected-field never retries (test_a_rejected_field_is_never_retried asserts calls['n']==1). NB: BUG FIX 2 on the FE — the phone-only prompt is caught by the CLIENT mirror in WalletCard.submitContact (identical rule to pay.contact_rejection: national digits, unique-digit-count<=2), so the round trip is avoided when the client already knows. Server-side backing is intact (test_checkout_returns_an_inline_field_error_for_a_fake_number in test_checkout_502.py). Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView / other RN issues: none observed.
action_items: None — all three bug fixes verified from the LOG (throttling reuse, phone rejection, 503/400/502 error triage), independently and end-to-end on the mobile UI. No remaining user-input -> 502 path found in create_topup_order / razorpay_request.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/payments.create_topup_order (line ~536-551) does link reuse via a Mongo find_one with status='created' AND amount==body.amount AND currency==currency AND expires_at>now_iso — exact-match reuse only, so a different amount can never adopt the wrong link and an expired/captured/other-account link is never handed back. The three positive-and-negative reuse invariants were checked independently.

routes/payments.contact_rejection (line ~373-399) refuses only patterns no real mobile number has (unique-digit-count<=2 and ascending/descending 10-digit walks) — narrow enough to preserve every real number in the review-request whitelist. Anything subtler that Razorpay dislikes still gets mapped back to contact_invalid:<field>: via customer_field_for, so a miss here becomes an inline field error rather than a 502.

razorpay_pay.razorpay_request (line ~68-96) retries exactly once on is_rate_limited and NEVER on anything else — verified by test_throttling_is_retried_once_then_reported_as_busy_not_broken (calls==2) and test_a_rejected_field_is_never_retried (calls==1). The fallback description '<status> <reason>: <text[:200]>' guarantees a non-empty error message even when Razorpay returns an empty body, matching the two logged failures the review flagged.

routes/payments.customer_field_for maps 'contact/phone/recurring digits' -> contact, 'email' -> email, 'name' -> name, with everything else (throttling, auth failure) correctly returning None — so unrelated Razorpay failures still 502 and only genuine field problems become 400 contact_invalid:<field>: to the client. No hallucinated field attributions.

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: pytest.ini pins '-n 2 --dist loadscope' in addopts. DO NOT run with `-o addopts=''` on the FULL regression — 30 tests (two_currency, security_iter20/21, tradingagents history) rely on that xdist setup and fail spuriously when run serially. The focused suite tests/test_checkout_502.py is xdist-safe and can be run either way. AUTH_DEBUG_RETURN_OTP is back at false on disk, backend restarted. WalletCard.submitContact has a CLIENT-side mirror of pay.contact_rejection (unique-digit-count<=2) that catches 9999999999 before /pay/order — this is intentional and desirable, but it means an FE test cannot rely on getting a server 400 back for that exact number; the same server rule is still exercised by test_checkout_returns_an_inline_field_error_for_a_fake_number in test_checkout_502.py.
rca_of_issue: The uploaded report RAZORPAY_502_NEW_USERS.md guessed the customer 'name' field. The server log recorded the real causes on every failure: 38x 'Too many requests' (Razorpay throttling), 4x 'Recurring digits in customer contact are disallowed' (a fake phone typed by new users who had no phone on file), and 6x a 400 with an EMPTY description (unreadable). The 3-part fix in this pass is: (1) link reuse — /pay/order now hands back the still-open link for the same wallet/amount/currency instead of asking Razorpay to create a second one, so the 38 throttling 502s can't happen from a double-tap; the reuse is exact-match (status='created' AND amount AND currency AND expires_at>now) so a different amount, expired link, captured link, or other-account link is never returned; (2) contact_rejection catches the exact 'recurring-digits' family before the API call and surfaces it as 400 contact_invalid:phone:<msg> with 'real mobile number' guidance, and razorpay_request retries once on is_rate_limited only, so throttling becomes 503 'busy:' rather than 502; (3) the razorpay_request error fallback guarantees a non-empty description even for the 6x empty-body case, so the log will never be blank again. All three verified by test_checkout_502.py (43 tests), the independent script (13 checks), the full regression (649/9), and the FE mobile smoke (fake-number -> contact-error, valid-number -> sheet closes).
